scope: Existing item types only; no new gameplay items, recipes, currencies or balance changes.
semanticLookup: Also recognizes named ores, gems, elemental scrolls, keys, chests, compass, coins and blueprints if present in item data.
unmapped: No current runtime item consumes the remaining mana stones, star fragments, most ore/gem types, keys, chests, journal, letter, star chart or bell. Their art is retained for future matching.
